items.item_text: Bachelor's Degree and/or equivalent combination of education & experience
Minimum of 5 years as a project lead in a business/admin unit within a basic science/clinical department or service line.

The Department of Medicine is seeking a collaborative and experienced Administrative Officer to serve as a key operational leader supporting the clinical chief for the GIM - Extensivist and Palliative Care. In this position, you will oversee a broad portfolio of administrative and operational functions for a nationally recognized, research-intensive academic division, including finance, human resources, faculty and staff administration, strategic planning, facilities, and operational initiatives. The Administrative Officer will partner closely with departmental leadership to optimize day-to-day operations, drive process improvements, and ensure the successful execution of the division's academic, clinical, and research missions. This is an exceptional opportunity for a proactive leader who thrives in a fast-paced environment and enjoys supporting innovative programs that advance patient care, education, and groundbreaking research.
Understanding of the concepts of strategic leadership, planning and change management approaches in a complex environment, preferably a research-intensive medical school/health system.
Understanding of financial planning concepts as it pertains to academic health care, research and higher education.
Ability to demonstrate an entry level of diplomacy in persuading and influencing people at various levels to achieve results.
Ability to identify and analyze pertinent information/data to make and communicate recommendations and decisions.
Ability as a partner to maintain a culture of integrity and accountability. (Required)
Ability to serve as a receptive listener and seeks to understand the differing sides of each situation.
Demonstrated ability to communicate medical, policy and administrative information in English.
